metadata.case_name: LAW MUK YAU v. SO CHEUK PO T/A PO KEE LOGISTICS

source: Further X-ray of left wrist showed avulsion fracture of the triquetrum.
His diagnosis was avulsion fracture of the triquetrum.

manifestations.description: occasional pain of left hand and wrist
tenderness and swelling over the left wrist
decrease of the range of movement of left wrist
weakness of left hand and wrist

treatments_received: Accident & Emergency Department attendances at Queen Elizabeth Hospital

losses.description: Residual pain and weakness of left wrist with occasional pain, decreased range of movement, weakness and cramp.
Reduced work efficiency and competitiveness; now working as a baking assistant rather than returning to work as a master baker, with a reduction in monthly earnings.

comparable_cases.case_name: Lee Yuk Man v Hillbery Limited trading as Tsui King Lau Restaurant (FWS) (in liquidation)
comparable_cases.injury_description: right chest contusion and fracture triquetrum of the right wrist; residual pain at right wrist and right chest; splint for about 2 weeks.

comparable_cases.case_name: Tang Shu Shek v Leung Chi Kit & Anor.
comparable_cases.injury_description: fractured left scaphoid; hospitalised for 2 days; plaster cast for 2 months; diagnostic arthroscopy revealing degenerative changes; physiotherapy on about 40 occasions.

comparable_cases.case_name: Ho Bing Cheung v Lam Yin Tuk trading as Ocean Fast Food and Others
comparable_cases.injury_description: fracture of distal radius and ulna with plaster immobilization; hospitalised for 2 days; healed with collapse, impaction and deformity; complicated with Complex Regional Pain Syndrome and shoulder hand syndrome; residual mild back tenderness.

comparable_cases.case_name: Yu Yixin v Leung Chi Tin Andy
comparable_cases.injury_description: fracture of right distal radius and ulnar styloid; treated with closed reduction and short arm plaster cast; cast removed in 6 weeks; residual ulnar region pain; 14 sessions of physiotherapy; possible early osteoarthritis.
